exercises.why: «Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. In compound ordinal numerals only the last element is actually an ordinal, and only this element is declined.» «The first part is in the Genitive case: пятидесятый, двухсотый. This part does not change in declension.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 72, pp. 37–38.
